note: A crash report is lines of printable ASCII, each KEY VALUE, in the order of `lines`. A room builds its report from its signal handler's dump and addr2line's names; the API builds a page's from the page's crash event. The bucket is md5(SOURCE + ' ' + the sig line's value). A room's names are addr2line -a -f -i's answer: for each offset its own 0x line, then a function and its FILE:LINE for the code there and for each function it was inlined into.

lines.value: the room's release, or the page's module file
lines.when: room; a page when it has one

lines.value: the binary's build ID in lowercase hex (0: none)
the signal's name, or trap for a page
the address the signal names, lowercase hex
a Coax trap's own line, PATH:LINE: WHAT
NAME FILE:LINE (room), NAME (page), ? +0xOFFSET (no name) or ? - (outside the binary); innermost first, at most 24
MS US PLAYERS, the last ticks before it, oldest first, at most 16
KIND|NAME|NAME|NAME: the kind and the three innermost Coax functions; KIND|TEXT when no frame has one
